headline: Downer Shares Rise Following $730 Million Transmission Contract Win
summary: Shares in Downer EDI rose over 3% after securing a $730 million electrical transmission contract in New South Wales. The award boosts the Australian infrastructure services company's forward order book.
why: Downer EDI is an Australian integrated services provider operating in transport, utilities, and infrastructure sectors.

impacts.name: Downer EDI Limited
impacts.why: Securing a major infrastructure contract increases long-term revenue visibility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Downer EDI stock jumped after the company secured a $730 million energy transmission infrastructure deal.
